:::{#exr-direct-sum-equiv-practice}
#### Recognizing a direct sum by counting dimensions

Statement 2 of @thm-direct-sum-equiv recognizes a [direct sum](#def-direct-sum)
from [dimensions](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-dimension) alone.
Let $\mathcal{S}_1 = \operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)}$
and $\mathcal{S}_2 = \operatorname{span}\cb{(0, 1, 1)}$,
and suppose that you have already checked that $\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2 = \reals^3$.

Decide whether $\reals^3 = \mathcal{S}_1 \oplus \mathcal{S}_2$, using statement 2 of @thm-direct-sum-equiv.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find $\dim(\mathcal{S}_1)$ and $\dim(\mathcal{S}_2)$,
add them,
and compare the total with $\dim(\reals^3) = 3$.

:::

:::
